option_a: Live in a world where you can see everyone's health bar
option_b: Live in a world where you can see everyone's mood bar
debate_note: Health bars show who needs help; mood bars tell you who to approach and who to avoid.

option_a: Be able to speak to the dead for 5 minutes once a year
option_b: Receive a letter from your future self every New Year's Day
debate_note: Speaking to the dead gives closure; future letters give actionable advice about upcoming events.

option_a: Have a magical bag that always has exactly what you need
option_b: Have a magical wallet that always has exactly as much money as you need
debate_note: The bag covers every physical need; the wallet covers financial needs but not physical items.

option_a: Be able to communicate with any animal
option_b: Be understood by every human regardless of language
debate_note: Talking to animals reveals nature's secrets; universal human communication breaks down every cultural barrier.

option_a: Know every person's true opinion of you
option_b: Have every person genuinely like you
debate_note: Knowing opinions helps you understand relationships; being universally liked opens every door.

option_a: Be a professional athlete for 10 years then retire
option_b: Be a successful author with 10 bestselling novels
debate_note: Athletics gives physical accomplishment and fame; authorship creates lasting cultural impact.

option_a: Have the ability to stop time but you can't move
option_b: Have the ability to move at light speed but time continues normally
debate_note: Stopping time but staying frozen lets you observe; moving at light speed means you can do anything in an instant.

option_a: Eat only foods that taste amazing but smell terrible
option_b: Eat only foods that smell amazing but taste terrible
hook: Nose vs. taste buds — which matters more?
debate_note: Terrible smell ruins social eating; bad taste ruins every meal you actually consume.

option_a: Have 10 close, lifelong friends
option_b: Have 1,000 acquaintances who would help you in a pinch
hook: Depth or breadth in social connections?
debate_note: Deep friendships provide emotional support; a wide network provides access to more resources and opportunities.

option_a: Live 200 years but look old from 40 onward
option_b: Live 90 years but look 25 until you die
debate_note: 200 years means experiencing centuries of change; staying young-looking for 90 years has social advantages.

option_a: Have a dragon as a pet but it can't fly
option_b: Have a unicorn as a pet but it can't do magic
hook: Dragon minus flight or unicorn minus magic?
debate_note: A fire-breathing dragon is still impressive; a unicorn is beautiful and rare even without magic.

option_a: Always win every argument
option_b: Always know when someone is lying
debate_note: Winning arguments is powerful; knowing when you're being lied to protects you from manipulation.

option_a: Live in the world of your favorite book
option_b: Live in the world of your favorite game
debate_note: Book worlds have depth and narrative; game worlds usually have mechanics that make life more interactive.

option_a: Be able to become invisible at will
option_b: Be able to read minds at will
debate_note: Invisibility gives physical access; telepathy gives informational access to every mind around you.

option_a: Have a permanent 3-day weekend every week
option_b: Have 4 hours cut from every workday but same pay
hook: More days off or shorter days?
debate_note: 3-day weekends give long stretches of rest; shorter workdays give daily free time throughout the week.

option_a: Age 5 years instantly right now
option_b: Go back in age 5 years instantly right now
debate_note: Getting older now accelerates life experience; getting younger regains lost time but you lose some memories.

option_a: Taste everything you touch
option_b: Hear everything you see
debate_note: Tasting everything is unpleasant for most surfaces; hearing everything visible would be overwhelming noise.

option_a: Have a superpower that nobody believes you have
option_b: Not have any superpower but everyone believes you do
hook: Real power with no credit, or fake power with full credit?
debate_note: Real power is useful regardless of belief; perceived power has social benefits even without the reality.

option_a: Be the best at one thing in the world
option_b: Be above average at everything
hook: World-class at one or good at everything?
debate_note: Being best in world at one thing brings recognition; being above average at everything is extremely versatile.

option_a: Hiccup every time you lie
option_b: Sneeze every time you're about to make a mistake
hook: Lie detector body or mistake alarm?
debate_note: Hiccupping when lying is humiliating but keeps you honest; sneezing before mistakes could save you from disasters.

option_a: Have a photographic memory but only for useless trivia
option_b: Have perfect recall but only for conversations you've had
debate_note: Trivia memory wins game shows; perfect recall of conversations helps relationships and negotiations.

option_a: Be able to talk to computers and have them understand you perfectly
option_b: Be able to fix any broken object just by touching it
debate_note: Perfect computer communication is extremely valuable in the digital age; fixing anything by touch is magical utility.

option_a: Have a free pass to travel anywhere in the world for 1 year
option_b: Have every expense paid in your current city for 1 year
hook: See the world or live rent-free?
debate_note: World travel broadens perspective; free living in your city eliminates financial stress for a full year.

option_a: Always be slightly too cold
option_b: Always be slightly too warm
hook: Chilly or toasty — pick your discomfort
debate_note: Slightly cold means always needing a jacket; slightly warm means always being faintly sweaty.

option_a: Have a robot assistant that does 50% of your work
option_b: Have a human assistant who does 100% of your admin tasks
debate_note: A robot handles half of everything but imperfectly; a human handles admin perfectly and intuitively.

option_a: Be incredibly charismatic but average in intelligence
option_b: Be incredibly intelligent but barely charismatic
hook: Charm or brains — which opens more doors?
debate_note: Charisma wins social and political situations; intelligence wins in technical and analytical fields.

option_a: Have unlimited battery life on all your devices forever
option_b: Have unlimited data and perfect signal everywhere forever
hook: Power or connection — which do you need more?
debate_note: Unlimited battery means never being tethered; unlimited data/signal means always connected.

option_a: Know exactly what your pet is thinking
option_b: Have your pet live as long as you do
debate_note: Knowing pet thoughts is fascinating; having a lifelong pet companion eliminates the heartbreak of pet loss.

option_a: Be able to control the weather
option_b: Be able to control traffic
debate_note: Weather control affects agriculture, disasters, and climate; traffic control has daily quality-of-life impact.

option_a: Have every movie ever made available offline on your phone
option_b: Have every song ever made available offline on your phone
hook: Cinema or music — which matters more?
debate_note: All movies covers entertainment; all music covers mood, workout, focus — more daily utility.

option_a: Be a master chef who hates eating
option_b: Be someone who loves eating but can't cook at all
hook: Create food you can't enjoy or enjoy food you can't create?
debate_note: Chef skills create a career; loving food without skill just means relying on others or restaurants.

option_a: Have a permanent smile on your face
option_b: Have a permanent look of mild confusion on your face
debate_note: A permanent smile is charming but may seem unsettling in serious situations; confused looks seem approachable.

option_a: Be able to take a 10-second power nap that equals 8 hours of sleep
option_b: Be able to eat one pill that gives you a full day's nutrition
debate_note: 10-second sleep gives 8 hours of freedom; nutrient pills eliminate all food preparation and cost.

option_a: Have the strength of 100 people
option_b: Have the speed of 100 people combined
debate_note: Strength lets you lift anything; speed lets you outrun, outwork, and accomplish anything faster.

option_a: Be able to speak every programming language fluently
option_b: Be able to build any physical thing with your hands perfectly
hook: Code the digital world or build the physical one?
debate_note: Programming fluency is extremely valuable in the tech age; master craftsmanship is rare and timeless.

option_a: Never stub your toe again
option_b: Never bite your cheek while eating again
hook: Toe or cheek — which pain do you fear more?
debate_note: Both are unexpectedly excruciating. Stubbing a toe is acute; biting your cheek ruins the whole meal.

option_a: Be the funniest person in any room
option_b: Be the most interesting person in any room
debate_note: Funny people are loved immediately; interesting people are remembered and sought after.

option_a: Have the ability to instantly understand any machine
option_b: Have the ability to instantly understand any animal
debate_note: Understanding machines is practical in a technological world; understanding animals reveals nature's secret languages.

option_a: Be a bird that can't fly
option_b: Be a fish that can't swim
debate_note: Flightless birds still live on land; a fish that can't swim is trapped in its natural environment.

option_a: Live in a treehouse in a forest
option_b: Live on a houseboat on the ocean
debate_note: Treehouse offers nature, birds, and calm; houseboat offers freedom, movement, and ocean air.

option_a: Be able to communicate with insects
option_b: Be able to communicate with sea creatures
debate_note: Insect communication reveals a massive hidden civilization; sea creature communication opens up the deep ocean.

option_a: Have the memory of an elephant (never forget anything)
option_b: Have the night vision of a cat
debate_note: Perfect memory is academically and professionally invaluable; night vision is practically useful and socially impressive.

option_a: Be able to create food from nothing
option_b: Be able to make anyone fall asleep instantly
hook: Feed the world or end any conflict?
debate_note: Creating food solves hunger; instant sleep could stop violence, end arguments, and save lives.

option_a: Always have just enough money but never struggle
option_b: Have huge wealth but constant financial anxiety
debate_note: Enough money without stress is profoundly peaceful; great wealth offers opportunity despite stress.

option_a: Be able to record your dreams and replay them
option_b: Be able to control your dreams every night (lucid dreaming)
debate_note: Recording dreams makes them shareable and analyzable; lucid dreaming makes every night an adventure.

option_a: Have the ability to instantly become an expert in any field you choose once a year
option_b: Have the ability to reset any one decision once per year
debate_note: Yearly expertise lets you grow; yearly decision reset protects you from your worst choice.

option_a: Only eat foods from one country for the rest of your life
option_b: Only eat foods that are one color for the rest of your life
debate_note: One country's food still offers enormous variety; one color severely limits what you can eat nutritionally.

option_a: Have the power to grow any plant instantly
option_b: Have the power to heal any wound instantly
debate_note: Instant plant growth could solve food crises; healing wounds saves lives in emergencies.

option_a: Live in a society where money doesn't exist
option_b: Live in a society where no one ever lies
hook: No money or no lies — which utopia?
debate_note: No money means bartering and sharing resources; no lies means total transparency in every relationship.

option_a: Be able to breathe in space
option_b: Be able to survive without food or water indefinitely
debate_note: Breathing in space opens the entire universe; surviving without sustenance eliminates one of life's biggest burdens.

option_a: Only be able to use one app on your phone forever
option_b: Have a phone that never runs out of battery but can't update apps
debate_note: One app means choosing wisely; frozen apps stop working as the internet evolves.

option_a: Be able to jump as high as you want but land perfectly safely
option_b: Be able to sprint faster than any vehicle
debate_note: Infinite safe jumping means you could reach any height; vehicle-speed sprinting changes every ground-based scenario.

option_a: Have a secret room in your house that leads to anywhere in the world
option_b: Have a secret room in your house that contains anything you need
debate_note: Portal room gives travel freedom; supply room eliminates shopping, shipping, and scarcity.

option_a: Be the best player in the world at chess
option_b: Be the best player in the world at poker
debate_note: Best chess player is world-famous in intellectual circles; best poker player earns millions in tournaments.

option_a: Live in a house that cleans itself
option_b: Drive a car that never needs repairs
debate_note: A self-cleaning house saves hours weekly; a never-breaking car saves thousands in maintenance.

option_a: Have hair that perfectly styles itself every morning
option_b: Have teeth that perfectly clean themselves every morning
debate_note: Self-styling hair saves morning routine time; self-cleaning teeth eliminates dental bills and morning brushing.

option_a: Be able to hold your breath for 30 minutes
option_b: Be able to run a marathon without getting tired
debate_note: 30-minute breath holding opens underwater exploration; marathon endurance without fatigue changes every physical challenge.

option_a: Have free flights anywhere in the world for life
option_b: Have free accommodation at 5-star hotels anywhere for life
debate_note: Free flights mean you can go anywhere; free 5-star hotels mean you live luxuriously wherever you go.

option_a: Never have to pay for food again
option_b: Never have to pay for housing again
hook: Free food or free shelter — which matters more?
debate_note: Free food saves $5-15k per year; free housing in most cities saves $15-40k+ per year.

option_a: Be able to shrink to the size of an ant
option_b: Be able to grow to the size of a building
hook: Tiny explorer or giant of the world?
debate_note: Ant-sized lets you see a world within our world; building-sized gives enormous power but creates major problems.

option_a: Have a genius IQ but social anxiety
option_b: Have an average IQ but perfect social confidence
hook: Smart and shy or average and outgoing?
debate_note: Genius opens intellectual doors; social confidence opens professional and personal doors — arguably more of them.

option_a: Be able to predict natural disasters 24 hours before they happen
option_b: Be able to reverse any environmental damage instantly
debate_note: Predicting disasters saves lives through evacuation; reversing damage heals what's already been destroyed.

option_a: Have access to every library ever created throughout history
option_b: Have access to every lab and scientific instrument ever built
debate_note: All libraries give theoretical knowledge; all labs give the ability to test and discover through experimentation.

option_a: Be an Olympic gold medalist in swimming
option_b: Be an Olympic gold medalist in gymnastics
hook: The pool or the mat — which medal shines brighter?
debate_note: Swimming gold is celebrated at almost every Olympics; gymnastics gold comes with unmatched artistry.

option_a: Have eyes in the back of your head
option_b: Have a third eye in the middle of your forehead
debate_note: Eyes behind give peripheral safety; a third eye centered gives a larger visual field but changes your appearance forever.

option_a: Have the power to make anyone trust you instantly
option_b: Have the power to make anyone tell you the truth
debate_note: Instant trust opens relationships and opportunities; forced truth reveals what people are actually thinking.

option_a: Spend a week on the ISS in space
option_b: Spend a week 2 miles below the ocean surface in a submarine
hook: Space or deep sea — which frontier calls you?
debate_note: Space offers the universe; the deep sea offers Earth's most mysterious and unexplored environment.

option_a: Be permanently 10°C (18°F) warmer than everyone around you
option_b: Be permanently 10°C (18°F) cooler than everyone around you
hook: Human heater or human ice pack?
debate_note: Being warmer means sweating constantly in crowds; being cooler means shivering in already-cold weather.

option_a: Have unlimited willpower
option_b: Have unlimited creativity
debate_note: Unlimited willpower means achieving every goal you set; unlimited creativity means generating infinite novel ideas.

option_a: Have a library that auto-restocks with any book you want
option_b: Have a kitchen that auto-restocks with any ingredient you want
hook: Words or food — what fills you more?
debate_note: Infinite books feed the mind; infinite ingredients enable endless culinary creation.

option_a: Be able to communicate through music (your thoughts become melody)
option_b: Be able to communicate through art (your thoughts become paintings instantly)
debate_note: Music communicates emotion powerfully; art communicates visually and can be preserved as physical objects.

option_a: Know the lyrics to every song ever written
option_b: Know the rules to every game ever created
debate_note: Song lyrics make you the ultimate karaoke partner; game rules make you unbeatable at any game.

option_a: Have the ability to undo your last spoken sentence
option_b: Have the ability to remember exactly what was said in any conversation you've had
debate_note: Undoing a sentence prevents regrets; perfect conversation recall helps in negotiations, relationships, and disputes.

option_a: Live in a world where all music is free and legal to access
option_b: Live in a world where all education is free and accessible to everyone
hook: Culture for all or education for all?
debate_note: Free music enriches daily life; free education changes lifelong opportunity for billions of people.

option_a: Be able to lift 10x your body weight
option_b: Be able to run 10x your normal speed
debate_note: 10x strength is impressive physically; 10x speed changes everything from commuting to emergency response.

option_a: Always get a perfect parking spot
option_b: Never hit a red light when driving
debate_note: Perfect parking saves time in cities; green lights everywhere saves time on every commute.

option_a: Have the confidence to do anything once
option_b: Have the skill to do everything perfectly without confidence
hook: Fearless attempt or masterful but shy?
debate_note: Confidence to try once opens experiences; skill without confidence means hiding extraordinary ability.

option_a: Live in a city that never sleeps
option_b: Live in a village that never has crime
debate_note: Never-sleeping cities offer culture, opportunity, and energy; crime-free villages offer safety and community trust.

option_a: Be immune to jet lag
option_b: Be immune to hangovers
debate_note: No jet lag makes global travel effortless; no hangovers remove the cost of every social night out.

option_a: Have a button that skips any awkward silence in conversation
option_b: Have a button that ends any conversation politely and instantly
hook: Fill the gap or cut the chat?
debate_note: Skipping awkward silence smooths social situations; ending conversations instantly escapes any unwanted interaction.

option_a: Always land on your feet like a cat
option_b: Always find north like a built-in compass
debate_note: Cat-landing prevents injuries from falls; built-in compass prevents getting lost anywhere on Earth.

option_a: Have a conversation with your 10-year-old self
option_b: Have a conversation with your 80-year-old self
debate_note: Talking to your child self reminds you of joy and simplicity; your elder self gives practical life advice.

option_a: Work from anywhere in the world but never earn a raise
option_b: Earn double your current salary but never be able to work remotely
debate_note: Location freedom means experiencing the world; double salary means financial security even if tied to one place.

option_a: Have the ability to clone yourself once
option_b: Have the ability to pause your clone
hook: Two of you or one controlled you?
debate_note: Cloning doubles your productivity; pausing gives you a perfect backup when you need space or time.

option_a: Eat the world's spiciest food for one minute
option_b: Eat the world's sourest food for 10 minutes
debate_note: World's spiciest food causes severe burning; prolonged sourness wrecks your taste buds and enamel.

option_a: Never have to charge your phone again
option_b: Never have your phone die in the middle of something important again
hook: Always charged or never dead at the worst moment?
debate_note: Always charged means never worrying; never dying at the worst moment is more specifically useful but still dies otherwise.

option_a: Have a clone that does all your chores
option_b: Have a clone that goes to all your boring meetings
debate_note: Chore-free living saves hours at home; meeting-free work means only doing the actual productive work.

option_a: Live a short, incredibly exciting life
option_b: Live a long, quietly satisfying life
debate_note: An exciting life burns intensely but briefly; a satisfying life offers decades of contentment and depth.

option_a: Have the ability to delete any memory you choose
option_b: Have the ability to relive any memory in full detail
debate_note: Deleting painful memories gives peace; reliving beautiful ones preserves joy from fleeting moments.

option_a: Win a Nobel Prize
option_b: Win an Oscar
debate_note: A Nobel Prize is humanity's greatest intellectual honor; an Oscar is the pinnacle of entertainment achievement.

option_a: Have a reusable time machine that can only jump 24 hours in any direction
option_b: Have a one-time jump that lets you go anywhere in time
hook: Small jumps forever or one massive leap?
debate_note: Daily time jumps let you fix yesterday's mistakes repeatedly; one big jump lets you witness any historical moment.

option_a: Know every fact about the universe but be unable to share it
option_b: Have a modest understanding of things but be an incredible teacher
debate_note: Knowing everything is intellectually satisfying but futile if unshared; teaching well changes everyone you touch.

option_a: Have perfect weather every day
option_b: Have perfect WiFi everywhere you go
debate_note: Perfect weather improves every outdoor activity; perfect WiFi enables work, entertainment, and communication anywhere.

option_a: Always have clean, fresh laundry waiting for you
option_b: Always have a hot, freshly cooked meal waiting when you get home
debate_note: Clean laundry removes a weekly chore; a hot meal every evening is like having a personal chef.

option_a: Be able to speak with your past self once a month
option_b: Receive a written update from your future self once a month
hook: Advise your past or receive future guidance?
debate_note: Talking to your past self lets you guide your younger self; future updates let you prepare for what's coming.

option_a: Have a superpower that requires you to spin three times before using it
option_b: Have no superpower but be immune to all superpowers
debate_note: Spinning is silly but power is power; immunity means no one can use powers against you — ever.

option_a: Be stranded on a deserted island with all survival gear but no people
option_b: Be stranded on a deserted island with no gear but five other people
hook: Tools without people or people without tools?
debate_note: Gear means physical survival; people mean emotional survival, ingenuity, and companionship.

option_a: Have a pet dinosaur (herbivore) that listens to you perfectly
option_b: Have a mythical creature (any you choose) that has its own opinions
debate_note: A perfect herbivore dinosaur is safe and loyal; a mythical creature with personality would be a true companion.

option_a: Have a skill that makes you the best at your current job but nothing else
option_b: Have skills that make you above average at any job
hook: Master of one or jack of all?
debate_note: Best at your current job is immediately valuable; versatile skills make you adaptable across all career changes.

option_a: Be able to taste colors
option_b: Be able to see sounds
debate_note: Tasting colors adds flavor to visuals; seeing sounds makes music visible and noise extremely distracting.

option_a: Have a guaranteed 8 hours of perfect sleep every night
option_b: Wake up each morning feeling like you had the best day of your life so far
debate_note: Perfect sleep is the foundation of health; waking euphorically motivated makes every day feel like your best.

option_a: Live in your favorite decade of history for one year
option_b: Spend one year in a future century of your choice
hook: Explore the past or preview the future?
debate_note: The past has known context; the future is unknown but potentially extraordinary.

option_a: Have a magical pen that makes anything you write come true
option_b: Have a magical eraser that makes anything you erase cease to exist
hook: Creation or deletion — which power shapes the world more?
debate_note: A creation pen builds reality; an erasing eraser removes it — destruction can be as powerful as creation.

option_a: Always be the smartest person in the room
option_b: Always be surrounded by people smarter than you
hook: Lone genius or inspired by greatness?
debate_note: Being the smartest means authority but isolation; being around smarter people accelerates your own growth.

option_a: Have the best meal of your life every day
option_b: Have the most fun experience of your life every day
hook: Daily culinary peak or daily adventure peak?
debate_note: Best meal daily satisfies deeply but could lose novelty; most fun daily means constant excitement and variety.

option_a: Be able to make anyone forgive you instantly
option_b: Be able to make anyone understand your perspective instantly
debate_note: Forgiveness repairs; understanding prevents the need for forgiveness in the first place.

option_a: Have a magic wand that fixes any technical problem instantly
option_b: Have a magic wand that fixes any interpersonal conflict instantly
hook: Tech problems or people problems — which is harder?
debate_note: Tech fixes save time and frustration; conflict resolution saves relationships and mental health.

option_a: Have an unlimited budget for one month
option_b: Have a moderate but guaranteed income for the rest of your life
hook: One month of wealth or lifetime security?
debate_note: Unlimited budget for a month can set up assets; lifetime income eliminates financial anxiety permanently.

option_a: Have the ability to speak any language but only in whispers
option_b: Have the ability to sing beautifully but only when alone
debate_note: Whispering in any language still communicates; solo singing means you can never share your gift publicly.

option_a: Always have fresh breath
option_b: Always have soft, clear skin
debate_note: Fresh breath affects every social interaction; clear skin affects how you're perceived visually at all times.

option_a: Know every cheat code for real life
option_b: Be able to save and load your life like a video game
hook: Exploit the system or reset and retry?
debate_note: Cheat codes give immediate advantages; save/load lets you experiment with zero permanent consequences.

option_a: Have a personal assistant who is brilliant but brutally honest
option_b: Have a personal assistant who is mediocre but endlessly encouraging
debate_note: Brutal honesty from a genius improves your work; constant encouragement boosts morale even if it doesn't correct mistakes.

option_a: Have every book you read fully memorized forever
option_b: Be able to read 10x faster than normal
debate_note: Memorizing books means unlimited reference; reading 10x faster means consuming 10x more content.

option_a: Be able to turn any liquid into water
option_b: Be able to turn water into any liquid you want
hook: Purify the world or transform it?
debate_note: Turning anything to water is a purifying power; turning water to any liquid is an alchemy superpower.

option_a: Have the best coffee in the world delivered to you each morning
option_b: Have the best night's sleep of your life every single night
debate_note: Perfect coffee starts every day right; perfect sleep every night is the foundation of lifelong health.

option_a: Never be bored again
option_b: Never be anxious again
debate_note: Never being bored means constant engagement; never being anxious removes one of the most paralyzing mental states.

option_a: Have a GPS that always finds the fastest route in real time
option_b: Have a personal advisor who is always available and never wrong
debate_note: Perfect GPS saves commute time; a never-wrong advisor guides every life decision perfectly.

option_a: Have your dream job but at half the pay
option_b: Have a boring job but at double your current pay
debate_note: Dream job brings fulfillment; double pay brings financial security even without personal satisfaction.

option_a: Be able to hold any object and know its full history
option_b: Be able to look at any place and see what happened there in the past
debate_note: Object history reveals personal stories; location history reveals events that shaped communities and civilizations.

option_a: Live in a world where kindness is contagious
option_b: Live in a world where violence is impossible
debate_note: Contagious kindness builds positive culture; impossible violence would end wars, crime, and abuse entirely.

option_a: Eat your favorite meal for every meal forever
option_b: Have every meal you eat be a different food you've never tried
debate_note: Favorite meal forever provides satisfaction; new food every time means an endless culinary adventure.

option_a: Have the ability to make anyone laugh
option_b: Have the ability to make anyone cry (happy tears)
debate_note: Laughter is immediate bonding; moving people to happy tears creates deeper emotional connections.

option_a: Be able to see the world in infrared
option_b: Be able to hear ultrasonic frequencies
debate_note: Infrared vision reveals heat signatures and hidden things; ultrasonic hearing reveals the world animals communicate in.

option_a: Have a superpower that only works in private
option_b: Have no superpower but be world-famous for having one
debate_note: Private power still works; fake fame comes with pressure and eventually scandal when the truth emerges.

option_a: Receive a compliment from a stranger every day
option_b: Give the perfect compliment that changes someone's life once a month
hook: Daily small joy or monthly profound impact?
debate_note: Daily compliments boost your mood consistently; monthly life-changing words create lasting positive impact in others.

option_a: Have a robot friend who genuinely cares about you
option_b: Have an AI that perfectly predicts your needs before you have them
debate_note: A caring robot friend provides companionship; a predictive AI anticipates every need before you feel it.

option_a: Be able to control the difficulty level of your own life
option_b: Be able to add extra lives to your life
hook: Adjust the challenge or extend the game?
debate_note: Controlling difficulty means you choose your own level of challenge; extra lives means more chances to get things right.

option_a: Have the world's most comfortable bed that you never want to leave
option_b: Have the world's most comfortable shoes so every step is perfect
debate_note: Best bed makes sleep magical; best shoes make every waking moment of movement effortless.

option_a: Be able to generate any document or report perfectly in seconds
option_b: Be able to make any decision and always be right
debate_note: Perfect instant documents remove busywork; perfect decision-making changes every aspect of life.

option_a: Have a phone that never breaks no matter what you do to it
option_b: Have headphones with perfect audio that never break
debate_note: Unbreakable phone eliminates replacement costs; perfect headphones transform every listening experience forever.

option_a: Have the ability to instantly end a conversation that's going badly
option_b: Have the ability to instantly revive a conversation that's dying
debate_note: An escape button saves you from bad interactions; revival saves valuable conversations from fizzling out.

option_a: Be able to communicate across any distance with your thoughts
option_b: Be able to share an experience with someone across any distance
debate_note: Thought communication is telepathic texting; sharing experiences creates true empathy across distances.

option_a: Have perfect pitch (musical)
option_b: Have perfect spelling and grammar automatically
debate_note: Perfect pitch is rare and invaluable for musicians; perfect grammar helps in writing, communication, and professional settings.
